allow: Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Content AGENTS.md -Tail 25; '==='; Get-Content README.md -Tail 25; '==='; (Get-Content AGENTS.md).Count; (Get-Content README.md).Count")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command " $folder = 'docs\plans\universal-ai-workspace-framework' '--- FILES ---' Get-ChildItem $folder | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name '--- GAP ID COVERAGE (must appear in exactly 1 phase file) ---' $phaseFiles = Get-ChildItem $folder -Filter 'phase-*.md' $missing = @(); $dupes = @() $ids = @(); foreach($p in 'A','B','C'){ foreach($n in 1..12){ $ids += \"$p$n\" } }; foreach($n in 1..4){ $ids += \"D$n\" } foreach($id in $ids){ $hits = @($phaseFiles | Where-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw) -match [regex]::Escape($id) }) if($hits.Count -eq 0){ $missing += $id } if($hits.Count -gt 1){ $dupes += \"$id in $($hits.Name -join ',')\" } } 'Missing: ' + $(if($missing){$missing -join ','}else{'NONE'}) 'Dupes: ' + $(if($dupes){$dupes -join ' | '}else{'NONE'}) '--- README LINKS ---' $readme = Get-Content \"$folder\README.md\" -Raw [regex]::Matches($readme,'\(\./([^)]+\.md)\)') | ForEach-Object { $f = $_.Groups[1].Value; \"$f -> $(Test-Path \"$folder\$f\")\" } '--- OLD PATH REFS (blueprint self-refs to docs/reports) ---' Select-String -Path \"$folder\universal-ai-workspace-framework-blueprint.md\" -Pattern 'reports/universal-ai-workspace' | ForEach-Object { $_.LineNumber } '--- 40 COUNT IN AMENDMENTS ---' (Select-String -Path \"$folder\blueprint-amendments.md\" -Pattern '\*\*(A|B|C|D)\d+\*\*' -AllMatches).Matches.Count ")
